I have grown beans on this land since I was a girl, and I know beans make their own food in the soil like my mother taught me, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot. I will spread two wheelbarrows of cow manure on it because the land is mine and I want it to stay soft and good, and I will plant the seeds I kept from last harvest. My daughters and I will do the weeding and picking ourselves, but I will pay for five days of hired help when the pods are ready so we do not lose them to rain.
